home.title: Start with the path that matches your stone program.
home.intro: A faster path helps buyers decide what to send first: color direction, product dimensions, drawings, or a distributor brief.

paths.title: Distributor / Wholesaler
paths.summary: Build a repeatable color and SKU program for showroom, retail, or regional trade sales.

paths.title: Builder / Multi-family
paths.summary: Quote vanity tops, countertops, backsplashes, and thresholds from drawings or unit schedules.

paths.title: Hospitality / Commercial
paths.summary: Coordinate cut-to-size stone products for hotels, apartments, model homes, and contract interiors.

paths.title: Fabricator / Designer
paths.summary: Select materials, finishes, edge profiles, and samples before final drawings are locked.

steps.title: Need color approval?
steps.copy: Select up to four surfaces and request a physical sample kit before committing to a production lot.

steps.title: Need pricing?
steps.copy: Send product type, dimensions or drawings, material, edge, finish, quantity, packaging needs, and destination.

steps.title: Need a trade partner?
steps.copy: Share region, business type, expected monthly volume, and target product categories.

proof.title: Clear specification before production reduces avoidable risk.

points.title: Sample-first approval
points.copy: Colors, finishes, thicknesses, and variation expectations are confirmed before production.

points.title: Drawing-based fabrication
points.copy: Cutouts, edge profiles, backsplash pieces, packaging, and labels can be matched to buyer drawings.

points.title: Export-focused QC
points.copy: Orders can be checked for dimensions, finish, edge detail, packing, and shipment labeling.

points.title: Document-ready workflow
points.copy: Resources, safety notes, spec sheet slots, and compliance documents are organized for buyer review.

products.title: Shortlist faster before you send a quote request.
products.intro: Use these buying paths to decide which SKU family to compare first. Final pricing depends on material, drawing, quantity, packing, and destination.

cards.title: Fastest retail program
cards.copy: Start with 25, 31, 49, and 61 inch vanity tops in quartz or engineered marble.

cards.title: Project fabrication
cards.copy: Use custom countertop, backsplash, and hotel vanity programs when drawings or BOQs are available.

cards.title: Premium furniture range
cards.copy: Review stone tables for hotel, retail, and lifestyle furniture programs that need a stronger visual story.

quoteChecklist.title: Send these details for a faster reply.
items: Dimensions, drawings, cutouts, and edge profile

colors.title: Use color family shortcuts to build a balanced sample kit.

routes.title: White / Carrara
routes.copy: Best for vanity tops, builder programs, and marble-look quartz demand.

routes.title: Grey / Concrete
routes.copy: Useful for modern kitchens, hospitality counters, and neutral commercial schemes.

routes.title: Black / Graphite
routes.copy: A strong option for accents, furniture, premium baths, and durable granite looks.

routes.title: Beige / Warm Ivory
routes.copy: Good for warmer residential, hotel, and renovation programs.

contact.title: A complete brief helps the factory quote the right path.
contact.copy: You can send an early idea, but the fastest quotations include drawings or dimensions, material direction, quantity, packing requirements, destination, and any inspection or document needs.
